threshold_note: Moving boundary: trailing-504-day 75th percentile of the lead-shifted signal; threshold_value is its latest value (2026-04-22)
strategy_description: Hold SPY when the signal is below its threshold; hold cash otherwise.
lead_description: 252 trading day(s) signal lead + 1-day execution lag = 253 trading days effective
notes: Winner S4b_roc_63d/T2_rp75/P1/L252 selected by in-sample Sharpe on the common IS window 2006-05-02..2019-09-30 (IS Sharpe 0.9620; SPY 0.5150) and evaluated on the held-out OOS window 2019-10-01..2026-04-22: OOS Sharpe 0.3442 vs SPY buy-and-hold 0.8129 (below). Grid floored at L1 (OAS publication lag). Supersedes S6_hmm_stress/T4_hmm_0.5/P2/L0 (1.4083), which used smoothed full-sample HMM probabilities.

selection.objective_formula: in-sample (common window [common_is_start, OOS start)) daily mean/std*sqrt(252) of pos.shift(1)*spy_ret; winner evaluated on the OOS window with ECON-T4 deployable scoring (fillna 0)

is_window.rule: eligibility before alignment: a candidate is IS-eligible only if its own first valid return leaves >= 1260 IS observations; common_is_start = latest first-valid-return date among eligible candidates; IS metrics for every candidate computed on [common_is_start, oos_start)
is_window.validity: IS window only: is_n >= MIN_IS_N, IS exposure in [0.05, 0.95] (P3: share of days long), IS std > 0, IS annual turnover < 24, IS trades >= 10; OOS never consulted

selection.rationale: Winner is the IS-valid row with the highest IN-SAMPLE Sharpe (common IS window) over the published floored daily grid; OOS metrics are reported for that row only (no OOS look-ahead in selection). Regime signals (S6 HMM, S7 Markov-switching) are IS-fit and forward-filtered (scripts/_regime_causal.py).

legacy_oos_selected_row.note: OOS-argmax on this grid (pre-GH#251 rule), comparison only; see legacy_oos_selection_20261016.csv

sensitivity_own_is_start_row.note: IS argmax without common-start alignment; sensitivity only

previously_published.status: superseded: relied on full-sample, forward-backward smoothed HMM probabilities (look-ahead) and an L0 grid below the OAS publication lag

inference.note: expected max |z| = Phi^-1(1 - 0.5/N) over N distinct position series (two-sided, independence approximation)
